title: Keys — Sign CSR — payload
description: A request for a PKCS#10 certificate signing request (RFC 2986) for a key the custodian holds. The producer names the subject as structured attributes and optionally the subject alternative names; the custodian builds the CertificationRequestInfo itself from those and the key's own public key, and signs it. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

keyId.description: Identifier of the key the request is for, as `keys/show` describes it. Its public half becomes the request's subjectPublicKeyInfo and its private half signs the request. The key MUST be `active`, and `p256` or `ed25519`.

subject.description: The subject distinguished name, one attribute per relative distinguished name, in the order of the encoded RDNSequence: element 0 is the first RDN in the DER, conventionally the country. That is the reverse of the RFC 4514 string form (`CN=…,O=…,C=…`). Never a raw DER or DN string.

subjectAltNames.description: Subject alternative names to request. When present, the custodian adds a non-critical subjectAltName extension to the request's extensionRequest attribute — the only extension this task ever requests.

dns.description: dNSName entries: host names in LDH form (an internationalised name as its A-label). No wildcards.

uri.description: uniformResourceIdentifier entries: absolute URIs, printable ASCII without spaces.

RdnAttribute.title: RdnAttribute
RdnAttribute.description: One attribute of the subject distinguished name, encoded as a single-valued RDN.

type.description: The attribute type, by its X.520 / PKCS #9 short name (externally owned, carried verbatim): `CN` commonName (2.5.4.3), `O` organizationName (2.5.4.10), `OU` organizationalUnitName (2.5.4.11), `C` countryName (2.5.4.6), `L` localityName (2.5.4.7), `ST` stateOrProvinceName (2.5.4.8), `organizationIdentifier` (2.5.4.97), `serialNumber` (2.5.4.5), `emailAddress` (1.2.840.113549.1.9.1). Closed: an attribute outside the set is refused, never passed through by OID.

value.description: The attribute value as text. The custodian encodes it without normalising, trimming or re-casing it, and checks the per-type rules of the specification (character set and length), refusing a value that breaks them with `keys/sign-csr:subjectInvalid`.

Response.title: Keys — Sign CSR — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a keys/sign-csr request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/keys/sign-csr/0.1#response. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

keyId.description: The key the request is for. Echoed so a response separated from its request is still attributable.

csr.description: The PKCS#10 CertificationRequest, DER-encoded and armoured as RFC 7468 `CERTIFICATE REQUEST` text: base64 in lines of 64 characters, LF line endings.

publicKey.description: The key's public half, multibase-encoded exactly as `KeyRecord.publicKey` carries it, so the producer can confirm the request is for the key it meant without parsing the DER.
